backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining romantic-themed OKLCH color variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up fonts, metadata, and the root element for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component composing all site sections and managing celebration overlay state and scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Full-screen dialog overlay that displays celebratory messages and animated floating hearts after proposal acceptance.
frontend/src/components/CountdownSection: Section showing a live countdown to the next Valentine's Day using a custom hook.
frontend/src/components/FinalSection.tsx: Displays a final romantic quote in stylized large text.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple centered footer displaying attribution text.
frontend/src/components/HeartsBackground: Generates animated floating hearts that fill the site background.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with a greeting, message, and CTA button triggering smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/components/LoveMessageSecti: Romantic message section with a long heartfelt note inside a styled card.
Interactive gallery of six heart-framed photos supporting uploads, clearing, and default-photo fallback logic.
frontend/src/components/MusicToggle.tsx: Floating music control button that plays or pauses a background romantic audio track.
frontend/src/components/PromiseSection.t: Renders a romantic promise section with styled text blocks and a title.
Displays a proposal prompt with acceptance buttons and an evasive “No” button using interactive state.
frontend/src/components/ReasonsSection.t: Shows a grid of 10 styled cards listing reasons for love with emojis.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, refreshing queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and logic for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemoryPhotos.ts: Manages six memory photos with migration, storage syncing, defaults, and custom photo upload support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are needed.
frontend/src/hooks/useValentinesCountdow: Calculates and updates a countdown to next Valentine’s Day every second.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom romantic theme variables, utilities, and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, wrapping it in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom fonts, color variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: JSON file describing the project’s state, requirements, known issues, and deployment notes for a romantic Valentine’s Day website.
